data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1612 (commit 513a5134, LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1, submitted to main).

AC verification:
- AC1: shipped-surface scan now enumerates the tracked set via `git ls-files` and matches tokens as BYTES, so the ignored editor_assets esbuild Mach-O can no longer raise UnicodeDecodeError; test_scan_tolerates_undecodable_file_but_still_reports_token proves a stale token in a text file still trips the oracle, and test_shipped_enumeration_excludes_untracked_build_artifacts proves an ignored binary under src/rebar is excluded.
- AC2: the provenance fallback test no longer clones the source object DB (the shallow/promisor failure mode); it exports HEAD's tree and re-inits a one-commit fixture.
- AC3: the test still runs unskipped and now asserts the wheel bakes the FIXTURE's own short SHA — a value that can only arrive via the hook running git rev-parse in the build tree, so the oracle is strictly stronger than before.
- AC4: test_self_contained_checkout_survives_shallow_source builds the fixture from a genuine --depth 1 clone (asserts .git/shallow exists).
- AC5: no decode error is caught anywhere (bytes matching means none is possible) and no skip was added beyond the pre-existing git/build availability guards; the git-unavailable path falls back to a full-tree walk, a superset, never a silent narrowing. A guard assertion also rejects an empty enumeration so the scan cannot pass vacuously (757 tracked files, 56 pinned help texts still scanned).

Gates: make lint, make typecheck, 36 targeted tests, and tests/unit -k 'help or attestation' (197 passed / 3 skipped). tests/conftest.py needed no change — both fixtures are suite-local.
